يشترطوا (form VIII)
# يَشْتَرِطُوا (yaštariṭū) /jaʃ.ta.ri.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَطَ (ištaraṭa)
# يُشْتَرَطُوا (yuštaraṭū) /juʃ.ta.ra.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَطَ (ištaraṭa)
